AfterCardPlayed.rationale: ArtOfWar.cs:55-76 sets AnyAttacksPlayedThisTurn when an Attack is played, behind three guards the sim reproduces or does not need: `Owner != cardPlay.Card.Owner` is the multiplayer other-player filter (out of scope, single-player sim); `cardPlay.Card.Type != CardType.Attack` is art_of_war.py:27-28; `AnyAttacksPlayedLastTurn` is art_of_war.py:29-30. The per-Replay AfterCardPlayed multiplicity that makes relic/unsettling_lamp's G1 a gap is harmless here because the write is idempotent (`= True`). The remaining C# guard, `!CombatManager.Instance.IsInProgress`, is covered by guard N2.

AfterSideTurnEnd.rationale: ArtOfWar.cs:78-87 rolls ThisTurn into LastTurn and clears ThisTurn at the end of the owner's own side turn (`participants.Contains(Owner.Creature)`); the sim's on_player_turn_end fires only for the player's turn end, so the participants filter is structurally satisfied. Both then read the flag at the NEXT turn's energy reset, so the player-turn-end/enemy-turn-end distinction audits/seam/turn_structure.json step 39 draws does not reach this relic's observable.

AfterEnergyReset.rationale: ArtOfWar.cs:89-106: for the owner, from TurnNumber > 1 on, grant EnergyVar(1).BaseValue energy when no Attack was played last turn, then clear both flags. art_of_war.py:38-44 is a line-for-line match including the unconditional double clear, and turn numbering is executed-verified (py tools/audit/relic_probes.py turn-order: the sim's self.turn is 1 on the first turn, so `self.turn <= 1` and `TurnNumber > 1` partition the same way). The sim's on_energy_reset is fired at player.py:168, immediately after the energy assignment and before the hand draw, which is where turn_structure step 18 puts Hook.AfterEnergyReset. Amount 1 matches EnergyVar(1) (ArtOfWar.cs:25) with no ascension branch.

AfterCombatEnd.maps_to: no counterpart; the sim's flags are per-instance and never reset outside the turn cycle (art_of_war.py:23-24, 43-44)
AfterCombatEnd.rationale: ArtOfWar.cs:108-114 clears both flags at combat end. The sim's on_energy_reset already clears both unconditionally on every turn from 2 on (art_of_war.py:43-44), and turn 1 of the next combat cannot read them: the only reader is the `if not self._attacks_last_turn` branch, which turn 1 returns before (line 38-39). So a stale True carried across combats is provably discarded before it can grant energy, and the observable is identical. Unlike relic/belt_buckle's missing combat-end reset -- which IS live, because there the stale flag is read on the very first hook of the next combat -- this one is shadowed by a guard that runs first.

guards.what: N1: `if (AnyAttacksPlayedLastTurn) return;` inside AfterCardPlayed (ArtOfWar.cs:69-72) is DEAD in the source
guards.rationale: AfterEnergyReset clears AnyAttacksPlayedLastTurn unconditionally at the end of every turn>1 setup (ArtOfWar.cs:103), and it starts false, so it is never true while cards are being played. The sim copies the guard anyway (art_of_war.py:29-30), so both codebases carry the same dead branch -- a faithful port of a no-op. Recorded because it otherwise reads like a live asymmetry.

A card resolving as combat ends must not arm the relic. The sim reaches the same place structurally: combat.py's play loop breaks out on `self._all_enemies_dead() or self.player.is_dead` (combat.py:493-494) before further hooks, and the flag it would set is cleared at the next turn's energy reset regardless. No path grants energy off a post-combat card play.

guards.what: N3: base.Status transitions Normal/Active (ArtOfWar.cs:73, 95, 110) and Flash() (line 100)
guards.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / base.Status = RelicStatus.* are presentation only (the relic card's glow and its greyed/active state in the relic bar); the sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.
